title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1472: You know, i know, qin zhen doesnt know (1)

title.p: Chapter 1472: You know, i know, qin zhen doesnt know (1)

section.p: Lan Tian was crazy.
Worried, Su Yu opened his 360 acupoints and focused. Before long, Old Zhou’s voice started ringing out in his ears.
“I have been wronged!”
Su Yu was dumbstruck.
Holy shit!
What was that
Was he hearing things?
He hurriedly shut one of his acupoints. At that, Lan Tian’s wails entered his ears, “I have been wronged!”
Su Yu opened his acupoint in stupefaction.
“I have been wronged!”
Two people were shouting the same thing.
Su Yu shivered.
Shit! Shit! Shit!
Was Old Zhou…resonating with Lan Tian?
Holy shit!
Yes. He had been wronged. Those were Old Zhou’s words.
“I have been wronged!”
Old Zhou’s voice assaulted Su Yu’s mind, giving him a sensation that his head was about to blow apart. Noticing his pale face, Old Hao hurriedly asked, “Are you fine?”
Su Yu looked up and answered with a trembling voice, “I’m fine. Lan Tian…is a lunatic.”
Old Hao frowned with contempt. Lan Tian was outside the residence. What was so scary about a threat that couldn’t enter the residence?
Sigh.
Then again, he did not deny that Lan Tian was incredibly terrifying. Meanwhile, Su Yu was still alarmed. Lan Tian had somehow triggered a reaction from Old Zhou. Were they resonating emotionally?
Or were they resonating through their daos?
Su Yu was certain that Lan Tian had yet to open 360 acupoints.
In that case, why was Old Zhou reacting?
Wasn’t he the only person Old Zhou could hear?
While Su Yu was worried, Lan Tian continued wailing everywhere, “I have been wronged! It wasn’t me! You’re framing me!”
The Invincibles were rendered speechless.
Was he done?
An Invincible shouted, “Lan Tian, are you done with your madness?”
He was tired of this.

The devils were the ones accusing him. It wasn’t like the devils and immortals had declared that they would go after him immediately. They only needed an excuse to prevent a war while they were inside the mansion. Why was Lan Tian wailing for something so minor?
At this point, even the Invincibles were starting to shiver. Something felt very wrong about this.
“I have been wronged! And now, you’re calling me mad? I have been wronged!”
Abruptly, an Invincible roared, “Impudent!”
Just then, even more Lan Tians appeared beside the non Invincibles all over the seventh level. They all wailed, “They framed me! I have been wrong! I am angry!”
Whoosh!
Then, the various Lan Tians started tearing the non Invincibles apart while wailing, “They framed me! You! You guys! Become one with me and serve as my witness! Tell them that it wasn’t me!”
In a split second, over a thousand Lan Tians appeared.
In that split second, he killed over thirty experts.
Some were Sunmoons and some were Mountainseas.

The Invincibles started attacking the clones. As a result, the countless Lan Tians wailed again, “You are hitting me? How can you? After framing me, you’re hitting me! I’m not scared of you! I’m not scared! I will turn you all into my clones! All of you will share my sorrow! You will understand how I feel!”
The auras of the various Lan Tians started surging.
A powerful sense of resentment flooded the seventh level.
“I have been wronged!”

The voices continued assaulting the minds of all the people on the seventh level. At this point, even the human Invincibles were starting to grow wary. Zhu Tianfang roared, “All humans, shut your six senses and return indoors.”
“Do it now!”
The other Invincibles were also giving the same orders. Those who were outside the Devote King’s residence could hear the mournful wails in their heads.
“I have been wronged!”
Somewhere on the seventh level.
Deep inside the mountains, a massive iron devourer was busy eating. When he heard the voices, he dug his ears and muttered, “Why is that lunatic messing with my appetite?”
The voice of that lunatic was making him feel like throwing up.
The iron devourer continued eating. After a while, he looked around and sighed, “A big change seems to have been triggered. Lan Tian…Lan Tian of the human race…shit. This isn’t good.”
Inside a certain building.
Hollow inhaled deeply and muttered, “Damn it! Did that lunatic cause a change of the Luminous Domain Mansion itself?”
The mournful wails continued reverberating in their heads.
At this point, the seas of willpower of the weaker individuals were starting to blow up. Noticing that, Hollow inhaled in shock. Damn it. This felt so wrong. Since when did Lan Tian become so scary?
Elsewhere.
Yun Chen’s expression changed as he hurriedly said, “Don’t move!”

He covered everyone with a layer of light barrier. Meanwhile, Bai Feng’s eyes were shining brightly while Wu Lan looked incredibly excited. The two were completely ignoring the madman. Rather, they were studying the changes in the realm barrier.
A tiny crack seemed to have appeared on the impregnable realm barrier. Bai Feng felt like he was looking at a massive vein.
“Go in.” Bai Feng shouted in excitement.
Yun Chen’s expression changed slightly as he said, “We don’t know what’s inside. We might not be able to leave after entering. Don’t do anything rash!”
“The pursuit of the great dao is a cause worthy of dying for.”
Bai Feng said in excitement, “Thank you for your help, Martial Ancestor Yun Chen. You can leave now. Wu Lan, let’s go! This is the most beautiful thing I have ever seen in my life!”
Wu Lan laughed and said, “I’m not seeing anything beautiful. I’m only looking at blood…”
The two dove into the crack without any hesitation. Inside, Bai Feng’s voice rang out, “Martial Ancestor, please take the others away.”
Wu Qi and Wu Jia were with them as well. Just as Yun Chen was about to say something, Wu Qi stepped into the crack expressionlessly.

Yun Chen raised his hand before lowering it helplessly. He gave Bai Feng and Wu Lan one look before looking at Wu Jia, who had also entered the crack in excitement. A complicated emotion welled in his heart.
The pursuit of the great dao was a cause worth dying for.
Such was the path of a cultural researcher.

The first principal had founded the Knowledge Seeking Realm with the various prefectures for the same purpose. To study the unknown. To explore the future. Many had spent their entire life pursuing the truth.

Such was the case for the first principal. Such was the case for Ye Batian. Such was the case for Wan Tiansheng. Studying the unknown. Exploring the future. In his search, Wan Tiansheng had followed the path of myriad daos as him. In his search, Lan Tian had followed the path of him as the myriad daos. In his search, Ye Batian had followed the path of hegemonic dao…
After a short reverie, Lan Tian’s voice woke Yun Chen up. He laughed with amusement, “Madman.”

But soon, a sense of loss enveloped him. He didn’t know if he should feel happy or helpless about this. This line of the multiple character faction was still filled with such lunatics. Not a single normal person existed in this line. In comparison to them, Yun Chen was abnormally normal.
Yun Chen felt empty. He was the most normal person in their line. Perhaps…that was also the case for his teacher.
Was a multiple character faction member who was not freakish and mad still a multiple character faction member?
They were refined. They were proud. But they should also be mad.
How could one become a true multiple character cultivator without a little bit of madness?

Right before his eyes, these lunatics had stepped into the crack. He could only stare as the crack slowly closed in. He didn’t know if they could return from this. But he still wanted to enter as well.
The realm barrier was extremely powerful. He had spent a long time attacking it to no avail earlier. Now that it had opened, the unknown awaited inside.
“Sigh.”
With a complicated sigh, Yun Chen stepped through the crack right before it closed completely. Since they were mad, they might as well further embrace this madness.
Rumbling sounds resounded throughout the seventh level.
The wails of Lan Tian continued reverberating in the heads of everyone. One head after another blew up.

This was happening to those from the minor races, ancient races, races with no Invincibles in the mansion, those separated from their dao protectors, those not seeking shelter in the ancient residences…
Eventually, the seventh level itself started shaking.
At this time, He Tu and Dummy attacked again. The overjoyed He Tu roared with laughter and said, “Even the heavens are helping me!”

The Invincibles guarding the entrance were furious. Some even glared at the devil king angrily. Damn him! Why did that bastard provoke a lunatic like Lan Tian? Without even showing his real body, Lan Tian had caused the entire seventh level to stir. And now, He Tu was taking the opportunity to attack as well. This was troublesome.

Nobody had the time to care about Lan Tian anymore. It wasn’t like they could do anything about him. They couldn’t even find him. Over a hundred Lan Tians had been killed so far. However, the more the Invincibles killed, the more Lan Tians would appear.
This was the very first time they had faced such a difficult opponent who wasn’t even an Invincible.
No, that wasn’t exactly accurate.
Wan Tiansheng was such a person. Su Yu was such a person as well.
Humanity had gone mad.
Was this their final madness before their final defeat?
At the same time.
With the arrival of He Tu, the floating saber above the pond was starting to shake again.
An indistinct gate started manifesting. Death spirits could be seen beyond the gate, but they did not dare to step out due to the pressure of the floating saber.
One of the death sovereigns grinned, “Soon! We will be free soon! We will be free of the Source Return Blade soon! Without this saber, the Luminous Domain Mansion will be ours!”

One death sovereign after another appeared behind the gate. Su Yu could see Xing Yue among them. The death qi in the Devote King’s residence increased in intensity. Sensing that, the Pseudo Invincibles in the residence started feeling ill at ease.
Damn it!
Was chaos really arriving?
One of them roared, “Nobody is allowed to approach this place! All who approach will be killed!”
